tools.name: quick_check
tools.description: Free, no sign-in, Pro or credits needed: 10 checks a minute and 100 a day per IP address (per account when signed in). Checks a public website live and returns its 0–100 AI search readiness score, grade, category scores, which AI crawlers robots.txt allows or blocks, whether llms.txt exists, and the

tools.name: audit_url
tools.description: Crawl a public website live and score how well AI search engines (ChatGPT Search, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude) can access and read it: 0–100 score, grade, category scores, prioritized fixes and a shareable report link. Costs 1 credit. Requires signing in with LLMready Pro.

tools.name: get_audit
tools.description: Fetch a saved audit from your LLMready account by id, including score, failing checks, AI crawler access and fixes. No credit cost. Requires signing in with LLMready Pro.

tools.name: list_audits
tools.description: List audits saved on your LLMready account, newest first, optionally for one domain. No credit cost. Requires signing in with LLMready Pro.

tools.name: generate_llms_txt
tools.description: Crawl a website's key pages and generate a spec-compliant /llms.txt plus an /llms-full.txt with page content as Markdown, ready to upload to the site root. Costs 1 credit. Requires signing in with LLMready Pro.

tools.name: validate_llms_txt
tools.description: Check llms.txt content against the llmstxt.org proposal and list errors and warnings by line. Pass `content` to check text, or `url` to fetch and check a site's live /llms.txt. No credit cost. Requires signing in with LLMready Pro.

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: Show how many LLMready credits are used and left this month. No credit cost. Requires signing in with LLMready Pro.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: audit_url, validate_llms_txt · Public sink: generate_llms_txt.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: audit_url, validate_llms_txt · Public sink: generate_llms_txt

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
